item.description:
0.7.0

The console remembers what you typed on it.

  • Command suggestions on serial. A switch or router console has no history of its own. PortButler completes what you typed on that device, in grey; press → to accept.
  • Passwords are never remembered. A line the device did not echo is dropped, and the value after words like password or community is cut off.
  • It switches off inside vim and less, after an arrow key, and while a password is being typed. Settings turns it off entirely.
  • A license file the app could not use no longer vanishes silently — it says what went wrong and what to do.
